# Mario Kart DS PopTracker pack

A PopTracker pack for the Mario Kart DS Archipelago world, using real MKDS artwork
throughout (`images/items/` - character portraits, kart icons, cup emblems/trophies,
course icons, mission icons). Auto-tracks over a live Archipelago connection (no
game-memory reading on PopTracker's side - it listens to the same item/location stream
the BizHawk client itself uses).

**The whole pack is generated by `generate_pack.py` - do not hand-edit `items/items.json`,
`locations/*.json`, `maps/maps.json`, `layouts/layouts.json`, or the `scripts/*.lua` files
marked "generated" at their top.** The script derives every name/id directly from
`worlds/mkds`'s own item/location tables, so the pack can't silently drift from the real
apworld. Re-run it (`python generate_pack.py` from this directory) after any change to
`worlds/mkds/items.py`, `locations.py`, or `rom_addresses.py`, then re-zip.

## Install

Drop this whole `mkds-poptracker` folder (or the zipped copy) into PopTracker's `packs/`
directory, then select "Mario Kart DS" when connecting to your session.

## Architecture (redesigned 2026-08-06 three times, corrected again 2026-08-07)

`worlds/mkds`'s 2026-08-06 redesign made every Cup/Time Trial track/Mission a real
location whenever its category is part of the goal at all - the player freely completes
whichever ones they want, and the goal is satisfied once enough of those real locations
have actually been CHECKED (the standard "any N of M" pattern - see
`worlds/mkds/rules.py`'s module docstring; `worlds/mkds` used to award a separate
fungible Trophy item on top of each check purely to give the goal something to count, but
that was removed the same day as a real design flaw - see the "Progress counters" bullet
below). This pack went through three passes finding the right way to show that, plus a
real bug fix along the way:

**First pass**: moved Cups/Time Trial/Missions off items.json's progressive-item design
entirely, onto PopTracker's real locations+sections system (map pins, native "X/Y
checked" display). **Second pass**, per direct user feedback after trying the first pass
live - Time Trial's and Missions' map panels weren't visible/discoverable in practice -
moved Time Trial and Missions BACK to items.json progressive items, now on their own
second tab; Cups/Grand Prix placements stayed on the real locations+sections map system,
with small pins and the cup's real emblem icon baked into the map background above each
pin. **Third pass** (this one), per direct user feedback after trying the second pass
live - two real problems found and fixed:
1. Every Cup (and consequently its Grand Prix placements) showed unlocked regardless of
   actual state. Root cause: `locations/cups.json`/`grandPrixTracks.json` had no
   `access_rules` at all - PopTracker apparently defaults an omitted `access_rules` to
   always-accessible (not documented, but confirmed live by this exact bug). Fixed with a
   custom Lua access rule (`"$mkds_cup_accessible|<name>"` /
   `"$mkds_track_accessible|<name>"`, PopTracker's documented `"$functionName|arg"`
   syntax) instead of a static item-code rule, since which cup is a given seed's free
   bootstrap is only known at connect time via slot_data, not at pack-authoring time - a
   plain rule can't express that. See `scripts/cup_accessibility.lua` and
   `scripts/autotracking.lua`'s `mkds_cup_accessible`/`mkds_track_accessible`.
2. Time Trial/Missions showed no distinguishable state at all. Per direct user direction
   ("revert to the previous functioning code"), these two categories were reverted to a
   2-stage format - but this over-corrected past an earlier, already-working 3-stage
   design, reintroducing the very complaint it was meant to fix. **Corrected 2026-08-07**,
   per the user pointing at that earlier-working version directly - see the bullet below
   for the current (3-stage) design.

- **Characters, Karts** - unchanged throughout: simple two-state toggle items (greyed out
  / fully colored), one free by name per seed (`character_unlock_order[0]`/
  `kart_unlock_order[0]` from slot_data), the rest received as Useful items. No
  completion concept, no location tracking - see `worlds/mkds/items.py`. Live on the
  "Main" tab.
- **Cups, Grand Prix track placements** - real PopTracker **locations**, each with one
  **section** per check tier ("Bronze"/"Silver"/"Win" for a cup; "3rd Place"/"2nd
  Place"/"1st Place" for a track's Grand Prix placements). PopTracker natively shows each
  location's checked/partially-checked/fully-checked state and its count. Cups render as
  small pins on a generated grid canvas with the cup's real emblem icon baked into the
  background directly above each pin; Grand Prix placements render as full-size pins
  using the real course icon. Both on the "Main" tab. Accessibility (whether the pin
  shows locked or reachable) is driven by `worlds/mkds`'s own per-seed cup-unlock state
  (one free bootstrap cup, every other cup gated on its own individually-named item -
  see `worlds/mkds/rules.py`'s module docstring) via the custom Lua access rules above -
  a track's placements mirror its parent cup's accessibility exactly.
- **Time Trial tracks, Missions** - items.json **progressive items**, 3 stages each:
  stage 0 (locked) is the real course/mission icon with a `"grey"` `img_mods` tint (the
  same `"grey"` mod toggle items use for their own disabled state), stage 1 (unlocked, not
  yet completed) is the same icon at full color, stage 2 (completed) is the generic
  `images/items/track.png` checked icon. Stage 0 -> 1 is driven by receiving that track/
  mission's own individually-named AP unlock item (or, for the seed's one free bootstrap
  entry, directly in `onClear` - see `worlds/mkds/rules.py`'s `choose_category_bootstrap`
  and slot_data's `time_trial_bootstrap`/`mission_bootstrap`); stage 1 -> 2 is driven by
  `AddLocationHandler` on that track/mission's completion location, same as before. Live
  on their own **"Time Trial & Missions" tab**.
  **2026-08-07 fix**: an earlier pass (see above) had reverted this to a 2-stage format
  that only ever showed "not yet checked" vs "checked", never "unlocked" - restored to a
  3-stage design after the user pointed at an earlier, already-working version. Unlike
  that earlier version (which used generic placeholder art), this reuses the real
  per-track/mission artwork already integrated into the pack. This also fixed a real
  functional gap: Time Trial/Mission unlock items weren't looked up by
  `ITEM_NAME_TO_CODE` at all before this fix, so receiving one was silently a no-op -
  `scripts/progressive_item_codes.lua` (generated) now tells `onItemReceived` which
  `ITEM_NAME_TO_CODE` codes are progressive (advance `.CurrentStage`) vs toggle
  (`.Active`).
- **Progress counters** (`progress_cups`/`progress_time_trial`/`progress_missions`,
  top-right of the Main tab) - three small "X/Y" text overlays (still plain toggle items,
  forced always-visible) showing how many of each category's top-tier locations (cup
  "- Win", track "- Staff Ghost Beaten", mission "- Clear") have actually been **checked**
  against the seed's real required win count (`required_cup_win_count`/
  `required_time_trial_win_count`/`required_mission_win_count` from slot_data) - this is
  the "am I done yet" signal, deliberately separate from the Cup/Grand Prix pins and Time
  Trial/Mission icons (which show "what have I explored", not "how close to the goal").
  **Fourth pass, same day**: `worlds/mkds` removed its fungible Trophy items entirely
  (a real design flaw the user identified - a Trophy copy could be placed by the fill
  algorithm at ANY reachable location, not necessarily the cup/track/mission it was
  "for", so counting received Trophy copies no longer meant the player had actually
  completed that many themselves). These counters used to count received Trophy items
  the same way and were rewritten to count checked top-tier locations directly instead
  (`Archipelago:AddLocationHandler` plus an `Archipelago.CheckedLocations` resync on
  reconnect - see `scripts/progress_categories.lua` and
  `scripts/autotracking.lua`'s `onLocationChecked`/`onClear`), mirroring exactly what
  `worlds/mkds/rules.py`'s `completion_condition` and `client.py`'s
  `_check_goal_complete` actually check.

### A real PopTracker platform constraint, and how Cups/Grand Prix work around it

PopTracker's locations+sections system only renders through the **map/pin** system -
confirmed against PopTracker's own docs while planning the first pass: itemgrids can only
hold item codes (not location/section references), and every map pin needs explicit x/y
placement on a map image. There is no flat-grid location-checklist widget. Rather than
hand-build real MKDS map art and pin coordinates (a much bigger undertaking, and not
requested), Cups and Grand Prix placements use **plain, procedurally-generated flat-color
background images** (`images/maps/*_grid.png`, built by `generate_pack.py` via Pillow -
solid color, no real cartography) as map canvases, with pins arranged in a simple grid
and placed at computed x/y. Pin icons still reuse the pack's existing real MKDS artwork
(cup emblems, course icons) - only the map *background* is generated, nothing about the
game's own art is invented. This mirrors a pattern the reference Mario Kart Double Dash
AP pack itself uses for its own non-course-specific checks
(`images/maps/driver_checks.png` - see that pack's `locations/kartChecks.json`), not a
novel workaround.

## Known issue (generate_pack.py)

`generate_pack.py` itself was accidentally lost from disk partway through the 2026-08-06
session (never committed - see NOTES.md) and had to be reconstructed on 2026-08-07 by
reverse-engineering the still-present, still-correct generated output on disk. Every
generated file except `items/items.json` (which intentionally changed for the 3-stage fix
above) was verified byte-identical (JSON/Lua) or pixel-identical (the two map PNGs)
against the pre-reconstruction output before this fix was layered on top - see this
file's own module docstring for details. Flagging this rather than staying silent about
it, matching this project's established practice of not overclaiming.

## Known issue

`Level 1 Mission 2`'s image and every other non-boss mission icon now correctly reference
the real on-disk filenames (`images/items/1-2.PNG` etc, uppercase extension) - the
previous pack's lowercase `.png` reference (a `README`-documented known issue) is fixed as
part of this regeneration. A separate real bug was also found and fixed while
regenerating: Level 1's "Big Bully" and Level 5's "Big Bob-omb" boss icons were swapped in
the previous pack (both files exist on disk, just assigned to the wrong mission) - now
correct.

## Status

Schema-verified against PopTracker's real documentation (`PACKS.md`/`AUTOTRACKING.md`,
including the map/location/section fields, `Tracker:AddMaps`/`Tracker:AddLocations`, and
the `AvailableChestCount` Lua API used to mark a section checked) and cross-checked
against a real published pack (Mario Kart Double Dash AP) for the grid-canvas map
pattern - but **not yet live-tested** against a real PopTracker install. If something
doesn't render or track as expected, that's the most likely reason; please report back
what you see.
